name: Thomas Waitz - § 29 - Am 4
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on North Macedonia
part_text: 29. Notes that certain Chinese diplomatic entities have financed paid content and opinion pieces in media outlets of North Macedonia without clear labelling; recalls that a 2023 analysis found that Russian state-affiliated actors had used Serbian media proxies to disseminate narratives hostile to NATO and to claim that the EU is pressuring North Macedonia to ‘abandon its identity’;
